name: onex
description: ONEX single-command local LLM delegation. Ships exactly one skill (delegate) — no hooks, no agents. The full ONEX dev skill surface (108+ skills, hooks, agents) is internal tooling and is not part of this consumer-facing package as of OMN-14688.

onex_cli.notes: OMN-16041: `omnibase-core` ships the `onex` console script; the `delegate` SUBCOMMAND is registered by `omnibase-infra` via the `onex.cli` entry-point group. Installing omnibase-core alone yields `Error: No such command 'delegate'` (exit 2). Both packages must be installed into the SAME environment. Installable from PyPI as of 2026-08-15: omnibase-infra 0.38.6 is published, so the declared pins resolve against the live index. Python 3.12+ required.
